UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with current mood status and identity

currentMood.description: Current mood description e.g. Happy, Focused, Relaxed

moodNote.description: Optional note or thought accompanying the mood

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Submitted as FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

Friend.title: Friend
Friend.description: Friend connection referencing another user's account ID

addedAt.description: Timestamp when friend was added. Submitted as FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

Reaction.title: Reaction
Reaction.description: Mood reaction or nudge sent from one user to another

fromUserId.description: UID of user sending the reaction

createdAt.description: Timestamp of reaction. Submitted as FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}.description: Public mood profiles of registered users

/users/{userId}/friends/{friendId}.description: Friend list for a specific user

/users/{userId}/reactions/{reactionId}.description: Reactions and cheers received by the user
